name: Engineer
description: Technical, project-forward portfolio for engineering professionals — electrical, mechanical, civil, industrial, and chemical engineers. Built around project showcases, technical competencies, and precision presentation.
designNotes: The Engineer template draws from technical documentation and engineering blueprint aesthetics. Deep Steel Blue (#1e3a5f) conveys trust and technical authority, while Safety Orange (#f97316) highlights CTAs and key metrics — the same color used on construction sites and industrial equipment. Sky Blue (#0ea5e9) provides a calm accent for secondary elements. The layout prioritizes PROJECTS above all else, because engineering hiring managers want to see what you built. Each project card includes a tech-stack tag row, problem/solution structure, and measurable outcomes. Experience uses a timeline with company badges. Skills are shown as grouped categories with proficiency indicators (not self-reported percentages, but tiered: Proficient / Advanced / Expert). Certifications get prominent badge treatment. The overall feel is that of a well-organized technical specification document — precise, scannable, and credible.
